name: CRF_ASSOCIATED_CSN
description: CRF table for information related to the patient CSN's.

columns.name: REF_DATA_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the subject name record.

columns.description: This stores the patient contact serial numbers associated with the CRF. This is the counterpart on a shared instance of the encounter event ID's on a payer platform instance.
